title.zh: 将奥三棉示市绕行公路更名为众议员Hilarion J. Ramiro绕行公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Ozamiz City By-Pass Road Located in Ozamiz City as Congressman Hilarion J. Ramiro By-Pass Road
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Ozamiz City By-Pass Road Located in Ozamiz City as Congressman Hilarion J. Ramiro By-Pass Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9467_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 2 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en: The Ozamiz City By-pass Road in Ozamiz City is hereby renamed as Congressman Hilarion J. Ramiro By-Pass Road.
The Department of Public Works and Highways is hereby directed to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
